summary: Frontend-only validation of GTFS-RT (temps réel) feature. All 3 scenarios PASS: (1) ADMIN /admin/transport renders gtfs-realtime-config section with badge 'Inactif (horaire théorique)' by default, 3 URL inputs (rt-url-mq-centre/maritime/nord) empty, and 'Enregistrer le temps réel' button visible. (2) Activate flow: filling rt-url-mq-centre with placeholder URL + clicking rt-save-btn → toast 'Temps réel GTFS-RT activé' shown + badge switches to 'Actif'. Deactivate flow: clearing rt-url-mq-centre + clicking rt-save-btn → toast 'Temps réel désactivé (horaire théorique)' shown + badge returns to 'Inactif (horaire théorique)'. Final state confirmed INACTIVE (no RT URLs configured). (3) CLIENT /transports-autour shows theoretical-notice ('Temps réel indisponible — horaire théorique (GTFS transport.data.gouv.fr)') and NO realtime-notice; 10 nearby stops rendered with theoretical departures (régression OK).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTransport.js now ~346 lines and starts to become dense — RT config block could be split into a dedicated GtfsRealtimeConfig sub-component for clarity, especially if more feeds (e.g. cross-island) get added later.
saveRt error path uses a single generic 'Échec de la configuration temps réel' toast — surfacing the backend error detail (e.g. invalid URL scheme) would help admins troubleshoot.

NearbyTransitPage.js: liveActive state is derived from r.data.realtime per fetch, but when admin toggles RT in another tab the user screen needs a manual refresh — acceptable for MVP but could be documented or auto-refreshed via interval.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! ; Client: test2@example.com / TestPass123! (both via /login/email)
seed_data_creation: None. Tests only toggle RT config on/off; final state left INACTIVE as required (no URL persisted) to avoid 8s timeouts on /nearby endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GTFS-RT config persists across reloads via backend (loadGtfs() repopulates rtUrls from r.data.realtime_urls). To assert toasts with sonner, page.locator('body').inner_text() after the action works reliably (toast text remains in DOM briefly). The save button is data-testid='rt-save-btn'; URL inputs are rt-url-mq-{centre|maritime|nord}; status badge is gtfs-realtime-status. Client page /transports-autour shows either [data-testid=realtime-notice] (when r.data.realtime=true) OR [data-testid=theoretical-notice] (default). DO NOT leave any RT URL configured at end of test — the /nearby endpoint will attempt a real fetch (8s timeout) and slow the user screen.
